SELECT m.name, ROUND(SUM(maint.cost) / COUNT(DISTINCT b.bike_id), 2) as cost_per_bike
FROM model m
JOIN bike b ON m.model_id = b.model_id
JOIN maintenance maint ON b.bike_id = maint.bike_id
WHERE maint.resolved_on IS NOT NULL AND maint.cost IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY m.model_id, m.name
ORDER BY cost_per_bike DESC
LIMIT 1;
